answer.answer: APY stands for Atal Pension Yojana [E01]. It guarantees a monthly pension ranging from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month after age 60, with subscribers receiving one of these amounts (Rs. 1,000/-, Rs. 2,000/-, Rs. 3,000/-, Rs. 4,000/-, or Rs. 5,000/-) until death [E03].
